objective: Define Personal Workspace and No-Campaign Home so zero-Campaign users retain meaningful governed Character, creative, reference, sandbox, notification and account capabilities without Personal/Campaign authority bleed.
design_findings: Personal Home is a first-class account surface useful with zero Campaigns and is not a global Player/GM dashboard.
Resources distinguish Personal-owned, Personal-accessible references and Campaign-private data.
Current A4 Campaign-bound Character records remain valid; Personal Characters require an additive context/policy successor.
Personal Character Campaign use requires explicit bind/clone/adopt/proposal validation and never implies membership/grants.
Campaign exit does not silently copy runtime Character state into Personal ownership.
CSW Creative Library/Projects are native Personal capabilities.
Personal sandbox/practice is isolated non-Campaign/noncanonical state and cannot transfer rewards directly into Campaign.
Personal↔Campaign transitions reauthorize and partition caches/search/realtime/recent work/notifications/AI.
Recent work and invitations are safe projections, never authority.
Leaving the last Campaign preserves Personal Home and clears protected Campaign state.
Personal import/export/recovery excludes unauthorized Campaign payload.
APM-02 receives a Personal Cozy host but no automation authority.
next_action: Open bounded APW-04 governance PR, run exact-head AIOC repository-health, merge after PASS, then close APW-04 and select APM-02.
